snippet.title: Sable's Grimoire - Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for Sable's Grimoire.

Sable's Grimoire is a visual novel about an aspiring magic researcher who begins to attend an academy filled with demi-humans.

Available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/717850/Sables_Grimoire/

Created by Zetsubou
https://twitter.com/ZetsubouGames

Music by Mario Luengo
https://soundcloud.com/mario-luengo

Sprites and CGs by Shadilyn
http://floradrawz.com

Logo and character designs by Adyrn
https://twitter.com/AdyrnDraws

Backgrounds by Vui Huynh
https://vui-huynh.deviantart.com/

GUI Artwork by Kingv
https://twitter.com/EnergyRain

Video by WhiteCharisma
https://www.facebook.com/WhiteCharismaLastFlight
